name: quota
title: QUOTA: The Factory Must Grow (Or Else)
author: Sal Aiello
description: A one-hour single-player Factorio roguelite. The Company drops you on a tiny island with a Shipping Terminal and a quota. Every shift the clock runs and the quota climbs. Between shifts: buy rule-bending contracts, technology, supply drops and new land rising out of the sea. Gremlins, earthquakes, meteor storms, union strikes and, at the end, The Audit. Hijacks any new game: start a new game and you are already on the clock.
